blocks.text: I will take the investor conversations myself, with Kimberly on each call to keep notes. Michelle will look after the scheduling, and she will also speak informally with the reporters who cover the company, most of whom she already knows.

We would very much like to speak with your leadership team as well, and ideally before the first investor calls take place. Hearing first how {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} sees itself gives us something against which to measure the outside views, and it tends to make the investor conversations sharper.
Could you let us know, by the end of this week, which colleagues you would like us to include? Michelle will then arrange a time directly with each of them.
